compiled_state.title: RED: Write failing tests for format-recipe-result.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Create tests/scripts/test-format-recipe-result.sh defining expected behavior of a JSON-to-summary translation helper before implementation.

## Why
TDD RED phase: the translation layer (executor JSON → human-readable summary) is the only independently testable new behavior in this story. Sprint SKILL.md changes are instruction-only.

## Acceptance Criteria
- test-format-recipe-result.sh exists and is executable
- Tests cover: (a) success case: exit_code=0, N transforms_applied, files_changed list → summary includes recipe name, engine, file list, transform count, and SUCCESS status; (b) failure case: exit_code=1, errors array present → summary includes FAILED status, error messages, and note that pre-recipe git stash snapshot is preserved; (c) degraded case: degraded=true → summary includes DEGRADED label and engine_name; (d) invalid JSON input → exits non-zero with error to stderr; (e) empty/missing files_changed with exit_code=0 → still outputs SUCCESS summary (zero-file transforms are valid for add-parameter on already-imported modules)
- Tests accept recipe name as first arg and JSON as stdin (or as second arg)
- All tests FAIL before Task 2 is complete

## File Impact
- CREATE: tests/scripts/test-format-recipe-result.sh

## Testing Mode
RED — write failing tests first

## Dependencies
None
